definitions.explanation: A person with exceptional skill or ability; also used as a modifier meaning 'highly skilled.'

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{凄腕|すごうで}の{弁護士|べんごし}だ。
{凄腕|すごうで}シェフの{料理|りょうり}を{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: To enjoy the cuisine of a highly skilled chef.

examples.japanese: {凄腕|すごうで}ハッカーに{狙|ねら}われた。
examples.english: I was targeted by an expert hacker.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{凄|すご}い (amazing) + {腕|うで} (arm, skill) → amazing skill = expert

USAGE:
Often used as a modifier before occupation nouns:
・{凄腕|すごうで}の{弁護士|べんごし} - expert lawyer
・{凄腕|すごうで}シェフ - master chef
・{凄腕|すごうで}ハッカー - skilled hacker
・{凄腕|すごうで}{営業|えいぎょう}マン - ace salesperson

NUANCE:
{凄腕|すごうで} has a slightly informal, admiring tone. It suggests someone whose skills are impressive or even intimidating. Often used in media and casual speech.

RELATED WORDS:
・{腕前|うでまえ} - skill, ability
・{敏腕|びんわん} - capable, competent (more formal)
・{達人|たつじん} - master, expert
